label: Schools (open, 2015)
aggregation: count of open schools (all levels) by county
notes: 2015 school census (SSSAMS) - latest open school-level data; treated as static baseline.

label: Schools per 100k people
notes: 2015 school census (SSSAMS) - latest open school-level data; treated as static baseline.

label: School enrolment (2015)
aggregation: sum of reported enrolment (female+male) over reporting schools
notes: 2015 school census (SSSAMS) - latest open school-level data; treated as static baseline. Only schools that reported enrolment (~3,300 of ~4,900).

label: Girls' share of enrolment (2015)
aggregation: female / total enrolment over reporting schools
notes: 2015 school census (SSSAMS) - latest open school-level data; treated as static baseline. National 2015 average ~0.38.
